𝑯𝒂𝒏 𝒂𝒏𝒅 𝑶𝒏𝒍𝒚 𝒊𝒏 𝑴𝒂𝒏𝒊𝒍𝒂: 𝑻𝒓𝒂𝒏𝒔𝒑𝒂𝒓𝒆𝒏𝒄𝒚 𝑹𝒆𝒑𝒐𝒓𝒕

It’s been 2 weeks since AHOF Fancon in Manila happened, and we are sincerely grateful to everyone who extended their support for our fan projects. With your generosity, we were able to collect a total of ₱33, 454 in donations. From these, we successfully unlocked and executed the following projects:

• Ha-dans Gallery
• Cheering Cat Banner
• Black Cat Glows Blue Field (Cat Bracelet)
• 5th Gen Eat Boy Treats (Snacks Only)
• Hanwritten Letters
• Cake for Han

[ 𝑺𝒖𝒎𝒎𝒂𝒓𝒚 𝒐𝒇 𝑻𝒓𝒂𝒏𝒔𝒂𝒄𝒕𝒊𝒐𝒏𝒔 ]

𝘛𝘰𝘵𝘢𝘭 𝘐𝘯𝘤𝘰𝘮𝘪𝘯𝘨 𝘍𝘶𝘯𝘥𝘴: ₱76,719
𝘈𝘭𝘭𝘰𝘵𝘵𝘦𝘥 𝘧𝘰𝘳 𝘋𝘰𝘯𝘰𝘳𝘴' 𝘒𝘪𝘵𝘴: ₱43,265
𝘈𝘭𝘭𝘰𝘵𝘵𝘦𝘥 𝘧𝘰𝘳 𝘍𝘢𝘯 𝘱𝘳𝘰𝘫𝘦𝘤𝘵𝘴: ₱33,454

A total of ₱43,265 was utilized for the production of donors’ kits, while the remaining ₱33,454 was allocated for fan projects. Out of this, expenses incurred amounted to ₱31,433, leaving an excess fund of ₱2,021. This remaining balance will be reserved for future fan projects.

[ 𝑫𝒐𝒄𝒖𝒎𝒆𝒏𝒕𝒂𝒕𝒊𝒐𝒏 ]

The photos attached contain pictures of the inclusions of our donor's kits, as well as the fan projects we've executed for Hani.

📌 Please note that there was no proper documentation for the delivery of the cake and Hanwritten Letters, as these were dropped off earlier due to the busy circumstances at the fanzone.

[ 𝑫𝒆𝒕𝒂𝒊𝒍𝒆𝒅 𝑩𝒓𝒆𝒂𝒌𝒅𝒐𝒘𝒏 ]

For a more detailed breakdown of the donations received and the expenses incurred, you may refer to the transparency sheet provided through the link below:

🔗 https://t.co/JYeJXgrqqt

Once again, thank you for entrusting us with this project. Your generosity and support made this possible for Han. 💙

#PARK_HAN #박한
#HANandOnlyInManila
#RENDEZVOUSinManila
